name: Ningbo Joy Intelligent Logistics Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Joy Intelligent Logistics Technology Co.,Ltd. is a firm dedicated to the innovation, manufacturing, and supply of sustainable and reusable packaging solutions. Its diverse product portfolio encompasses returnable containers, bespoke blister packs, customized material handling racks, conventional two-piece (heaven and earth) covers, and tailored internal protective materials, alongside specialized storage boxes for the modern retail sector. These offerings are critically employed across the entire lifecycle of automotive components, from their initial production and internal circulation to long-haul transport and warehousing. Established in 2005, the company maintains its headquarters in Cixi, China.
